parts.text: Drones fly along corridors between named sites that have only so many places to take off and land at the same time. The relevant rules are the EU drone operation rules and the EU U-space rules, and personal data of staff is covered by the GDPR. The service runs on a single server, is updated and restarted during working hours while drones fly, and occasionally crashes, but the companies accept a few minutes of interruption. Management reports, corporate identity systems, multiple languages, compliance audits, backups, passwords inside the service, and staff alerts by e-mail or phone are all things the companies do not want.
